hibs.label: the kings of Media and Persia
the people who are the saints
the youths
hibs.reconciliation_note: Added Dan.1.5 -- 'the king assigned THEM... THEY were to be educated' refers to the same selected pool described in 3-4, before the four are individually named in v6. Missed on the first pass.

quality_checks.is-genuinely-human: A collective of human young men -- unchanged classification, only verse coverage extended.
quality_checks.verse-actually-supports-it: 1:5's 'them'/'they' is the same selected pool named in 1:3-4, before the four are individually named in v6.

hibs.label: Ashpenaz
hibs.reconciliation_note: Added Dan.1.8 (Daniel 'asked the chief of the eunuchs' -- Ashpenaz is the addressee, present in the scene) and Dan.1.11 ('whom the chief of the eunuchs HAD ASSIGNED' -- Ashpenaz is the grammatical subject of the assignment). Missed on the first pass.

quality_checks.is-genuinely-human: Named human court official -- unchanged classification, only verse coverage extended.
quality_checks.verse-actually-supports-it: 1:8 he is Daniel's addressee ('asked the chief of the eunuchs'); 1:11 he is the grammatical subject ('had assigned') of the steward's appointment over the four.

hibs.label: Daniel
hibs.reconciliation_note: Added Dan.1.14,15,16,20 -- Daniel is part of the 'them'/'they' the test and its result are narrated about in these verses (he was omitted the first pass because he isn't individually named in them, only referred to as part of the group).

quality_checks.is-genuinely-human: Named human individual, the book's protagonist -- unchanged classification, only verse coverage extended.
quality_checks.not-already-excluded: Not previously excluded; already live from Dan 8 and the first Dan 1 pass.
quality_checks.verse-actually-supports-it: 1:14-16 'them'/'they' (tested, better in appearance, given vegetables) includes Daniel as part of the four the steward is managing; 1:20 'he found THEM ten times better' likewise includes Daniel.

hibs.label: Hananiah
hibs.reconciliation_note: Named individually 1:6,7,11,19. 1:12-14 Daniel's proposal is first-person-plural ('your servants', 'let us') covering all four; 1:15-16,18,20 use 'them'/'they' for the same already-identified group of four throughout the test and its result; 1:17's 'God gave THEM learning and skill... and Daniel [additionally]' groups all four before singling out Daniel's own extra gift. Corrected from the first hib.set pass, which only linked verses naming this party individually and missed the group-pronoun verses -- caught on a systematic re-read, per db-compare-adjudicate.
